svg.title: Billable · architecture overview
svg.desc: Local-first: every screen reads and writes through one store seam; the desktop shell adds only a guarded save bridge.
svg.text: Local-first: every screen reads and writes through one store seam; the desktop shell adds only a guarded save bridge.
RENDERER · WEB APP (VITE BUILD OF index.html + src/)

g.text: bind screens → createStore() → createDownloads() · createReceipts(store) → subscribe in fixed order
ui/ · one module per screen (renders the page, binds its events)
store · clients · entries · expenses · invoices · settings · timer · …
IndexedDB (in the browser profile / app userData)
read once at boot (getAll) into an in-memory mirror;
every write → put / delete, then notify listeners
